description.value: Sula is a Vancouver-based award-winning Indian restaurant established in 2010, named best Indian restaurant in the city by both Vancouver Magazine and Georgia Straight in 2025. The Davie Street location, opened in 2024, is their downtown outpost offering Indian fusion, tandoori dishes, and share plates alongside a full cocktail program. A touring cyclist passing through the West End or downtown Vancouver will find a full-service sit-down meal, brunch, and takeout options.
